svg.aria-label: Map of which cipher families the 24 known letters rule out at each key length 1 to 26
svg.text: What the 24 known letters rule out
Each cell is one cipher family at one key length. Evidence log for each row in results/.
Repeating key, standard or KRYPTOS alphabet
same, with any of 209k dictionary-word alphabets
same, after or before columnar transposition (every order, widths 2–14)
Any masking alphabet, then a repeating key
K1/K2’s cipher with any alphabet, Vigenère form
Trifid, any cube (key length = group size)
Ruled out: no key of this length fits all 24 known letters
Fits, but random text fits just as often: not evidence
Too few known letters to test
